'''Nerilea''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''. 

== Appearance ==
She is square faced.

== Activities ==
She accompanies Rand when he [[Travelling|Travels]] to [[Caemlyn]] after he had been captured by the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]].
